question: Can one full-rank nonlinear weight-space round-trip residual operator, applied to a learned target-free local score derived only from J's lawful 36 local features, reduce the frozen J autonomous OOF final-layer residual below 1e-8?
hypothesis: The autonomous bottleneck is sign/alignment reconstruction of the hidden residual state through actual full-rank network geometry. N proved rank-16 learned-span amplitude exists but is alignment-limited: its truth-derived span oracle caps at 2.8928320722187982e-8, capturing 10.535% of J endpoint error versus the 69.076% needed, while row gain correlates 0.948 with correction-to-negative-error cosine and only 0.024 with amplitude. A nonlinear round trip through each layer's own full-rank weight couples every unit through the true network operator rather than a learned low-rank factor, and is the sole graph-licensed successor mechanism.

authority.graph_node: P2R0F2P (sole open leaf; design-only until this freeze)
closed_axes_not_retried: rank-16 or any-rank low-rank covariance scaling (P2R0F2N closed)
backward adjoint recurrent latent state (P2R0F2M closed)

material_difference: P carries no new recurrent state, no covariance object, no low-rank factor, and no ensemble. It is a memoryless per-layer operator whose cross-unit coupling is the layer's own full-rank weight matrix used nonlinearly in a round trip. M's closed family carried a learned recurrent adjoint state across layers; P applies a static adjoint-then-forward round trip of the current layer weight to a learned local score with two scalars per layer. N's closed family learned a rank-16 factor span; P's coupling is the exact rank-1024 network operator.

scope.outer_fold_rule: blake2s digest-size-4 little-endian of ascii '1753358438:mlp_id' modulo 4; identical to P2R0F2D/H/I/J/K/M/N
scope.inner_fold_rule: blake2s digest-size-4 little-endian of ascii 'inner_seed:mlp_id' modulo 3, inner_seed = 1753358438 XOR ((outer_fold+1)*0x9E3779B1) using the full nonnegative integer product; identical to P2R0F2N

base.model: Frozen P2R0F2J four-channel transport-energy coherence observer
base.outer_scoring_model: The already frozen J model trained on the complete outer training complement (sealed fold_0..3.pt hashes)
base.inner_stacking_firewall: Within each outer training complement, train exactly three fresh J models under J's exact frozen architecture, loss, six epochs, exposure schedule, optimizer, and fixed final checkpoint. Each P-training row is represented only by the J prediction/states/energies of the inner J model whose inner validation fold contains that row; neither that row nor any outer-validation row trained that J model.
base.inner_j_seed_law: torch.manual_seed((1753358438 + 10000 + 101*outer_fold + inner_fold) & 0x7FFFFFFF); shuffle rng seed (1753358438 XOR ((outer_fold+1)*0x45D9F3B) XOR ((inner_fold+1)*0x119DE1F3)) & 0xFFFFFFFF; identical to P2R0F2N so the inner stack reproduces N's validated pipeline

architecture.name: full-rank nonlinear weight-space round-trip residual operator
architecture.convention: Row convention throughout, matching the frozen J/N code: hidden vectors are rows; W_l = weights[:, l] with W_l[j, i] mapping layer l-1 unit j to layer l unit i; forward transport of x in layer l-1 is x @ W_l; adjoint transport of y in layer l is y @ W_l^T.
architecture.qhat: For each corrected layer l in 2..15: features_l = the exact 36-feature lawful local vector J consumes (raw20 with feature 0 unstandardized and features 1..19 standardized by train-split centers/scales clamped to [-8,8]; per-channel message/rms m/R clamped [-8,8]; per-channel message/sigma m/(sigma*R) clamped [-8,8]; per-channel log1p(energy/R^2) clamped [0,8]; per-channel coherence m/sqrt(e+1e-4*R^2) clamped [-8,8]), with messages and energies produced by the frozen-J rollout states exactly as in P2R0F2N (zero at l=2, else m = Phi_l*(s_{l-1} @ W_l), e = J's cached energy observables). hidden = shared encoder Linear(36,128)-SiLU-Linear(128,128)-SiLU; score_l = per-layer head Linear(128,1); qhat_l = tanh(score_l), a dimensionless per-unit vector in (-1,1)^1024.
architecture.round_trip: u_l = (qhat_l @ W_l^T) / sqrt(1024); t_l = tanh(b_l * u_l); v_l = (t_l @ W_l) / sqrt(1024); delta_l = R_l * a_l * v_l. In column-vector notation with W the layer's own weight operator this is exactly delta = R*a*W^T tanh(b*(W*qhat)/sqrt(width))/sqrt(width) from the N receipt, with W read as the adjoint-first operator on layer-l space.
architecture.convention_resolution: The receipt formula requires qhat and delta to live in the same space as the domain of W. The only weight operators touching layer l are the incoming W_l and the outgoing W_{l+1}; a W_{l+1} round trip is undefined at the final corrected layer l=15 where the primary metric lives, so the incoming-weight adjoint-first round trip is the unique well-defined reading. This resolution is frozen before any metric.
architecture.R: R_l = layer_rms[l], the training-split host-error RMS per layer computed exactly as in frozen J/N moments_for; recomputed per outer fold from that fold's training complement only.
architecture.a_parameterization: a_l: one raw unconstrained scalar per corrected layer (14 total), initialized to 0.0 so training starts at exactly frozen J.
architecture.b_parameterization: b_l: one raw unconstrained scalar per corrected layer (14 total), initialized to 1.0. tanh boundedness makes every b_l numerically safe; sign flips are absorbed by a_l and qhat.
architecture.head_initialization: encoder Linear layers use PyTorch default initialization under the frozen per-fold torch.manual_seed(1753358438 + 30000 + outer_fold); head weights Normal(mean 0, std 2e-3); head bias zeros.
architecture.reported_output: Frozen J prediction plus delta at every corrected layer; layers 0..1 remain zero-correction exactly as in J
architecture.no_exposure_schedule: P has no own recurrent state, so no teacher forcing exists anywhere in P; J states are autonomous exposure-1.0 rollouts in both the inner-stacked training cache and outer scoring.

training.schedule: CosineAnnealingLR over every batch of all eight epochs
training.loss: Fit-fold-normalized corrected-layer MSE of (delta - (truth - inner_stacked_J_prediction))/R_l with fixed layer weights linspace(0.5,1.5,14) averaged, plus equal final-layer focus. No auxiliary penalties.
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 8 in every fold; no early stopping, no checkpoint selection, no validation-metric feedback.

decision_gate.pass: All conjuncts pass, followed by a separately frozen native deployment verification and literal meter before any submission consideration; this CV alone licenses no deployment claim.
decision_gate.fail: Close this exact full-rank round-trip spelling measured on any failed conjunct; no retune, no second checkpoint, no scalar sweep, no meter, no deployment. Produce a read-only P-vs-J decomposition and update graph.json, problem-graph.html, and problem-graph.md.

cost.ledger_convention: Dense vector-matrix products at 2*W*W-W flops; nonlinearity evaluations reserved at 64 flops each (258 per unit: 256 SiLU plus qhat tanh plus round-trip tanh); message/energy observables are computed once by the frozen J correction and shared with P exactly as in the P2R0F2N precedent, so they are not double-counted.
cost.authority: Conservative frozen source-structure arithmetic; literal meter only after the strict accuracy gate passes

launch_gate.order: preregistration -> run manifest -> program -> static synthetic check -> independent adversarial audit receipt -> seal -> sealed smoke (no truth metrics) -> training release -> folds -> aggregate -> independent verification -> decomposition -> graph update
launch_gate.independent_audit: A separate auditor with no stake in the design must check leakage safety (inner stacking, split law, target-first semantics, observer_selection closure), the convention resolution, the cost ledger arithmetic, and gate conformance to the graph terminal criterion before any seal; the audit receipt hash is bound into the training release.
launch_gate.condition: No --fold or --aggregate execution before TRAINING_RELEASE.json exists binding seal, smoke, and audit receipts.
